description: Pinned binstaller tools: a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=... [extractVersion=...]` comment sits above each version line.
Tools with a static checksum.value in config.yaml need that sha256 refreshed in the same PR; binstaller apply fails on a stale value.
dotbot has no comment on purpose: scripts/lib/dotbot.sh pins the same release with its SHA-256, so bump both by hand.

packageRules.description: Remind the reviewer to refresh static binstaller checksums.
prBodyNotes: If this tool has a static `checksum.value` in `modules/cli/files/binstaller/config.yaml`, replace it with the sha256 of the new release asset before merging. Tools using `checksum.discover` need no change.
